title: "U-2 detachment in formation over Nevada" – four U-2s in flight (Chapter 2, p. 78)
description: Black-and-white photograph of four U-2 aircraft flying in staggered formation against a dark background, their long wings appearing as light streaks. Captioned "U-2 detachment in formation over Nevada." The text describes Colonel Yancey's evaluation of the detachment's readiness and a 14 April 1956 engine flameout incident.
